fields.value: Nanoscale Networks of Metal Oxides by Polymer Imprinting and Templating for Future Adaptable Electronics

dsDescriptionValue.value: Data for the manuscript 'Nanoscale Networks of Metal Oxides by Polymer Imprinting and Templating for Future Adaptable Electronics'. The dataset contains the raw (and processed) data used in the manuscript, including data from AFM, cAFM, PFM, GISAXS, GIWAXS, and XPS measurements.
